Everything after the checkout, too

A run sheet for drivers

Each day’s orders by slot, zone and suburb, with phone numbers. Print a page per slot, and mark orders delivered.

What to pack

How many of each item for the day, by slot. Six veg boxes, five loaves, two bunches of flowers.

Move an order

A customer rings to change their time. Pick the new one from the order page, even if it’s full, and they’re emailed it.

Today at a glance

A dashboard widget for today and tomorrow, and a delivery date filter on Commerce’s orders.

Exports for any week

Orders or the packing list as CSV, from the control panel or php craft delivery-slots/export.

Headless checkouts

The slot comes back in Commerce’s cart JSON, and two actions list and hold slots.

"deliverySlot": {
  "value": "2026-11-17@10:00",
  "label": "Tuesday 17 November,
            10am – 12pm",
  "fee": 0,
  "isBooked": false
}

Different days for different suburbs

Draw your delivery areas with Geo Maps and give each its own days, order limit and fee. The van goes up to the Hills on Thursdays and Saturdays; the city gets every weekday.

  • Days per zone. Other days say “Not in your area”.
  • A limit per zone. At most four Hills orders share a slot.
  • A fee per zone. Added to the shipping, before tax.
  • Outside every zone? Delivery isn’t offered, so nobody orders a trip you don’t make.

Built with Delivery Slots

Complete checkout templates you can copy, from a grocer on The Parade, Norwood.

Grocery delivery checkoutDelivery or pickup, a week of days, two-hour slots with places left, and the order summary.
  • Zone days and feesThe Hills on Thursdays and Saturdays, for $4 more.
  • Click and collectHourly pickup times, the same day, ready in an hour.
  • Slot picker in JavaScriptLoads and holds slots without a page load.

The baker always came at seven

For three hundred years the bread arrived at the same time each morning, and everyone on the street knew when to open the door. Online orders lost that. Delivery Slots gives it back: a time chosen at checkout, and a shop that knows exactly how many orders it can carry.

Three steps to delivery times

First, install it.

composer require suprim/delivery-slots
php craft plugin/install delivery-slots

Then set the times.

Delivery Slots → Schedules, choose a shipping method, and add its windows, limits and cut-off.

Then add the picker.

{% for day in cart.deliverySlotDays %}
  {% for slot in day.slots %}
    <input type="radio" name="deliverySlot"
      value="{{ slot.value }}">
  {% endfor %}
{% endfor %}
$ composer require suprim/delivery-slots
  - Installing suprim/delivery-slots (1.0.0)
$ php craft plugin/install delivery-slots
*** installed delivery-slots successfully

Give every order a time.

composer require suprim/delivery-slots
